source.title: feat(ai98): provider-enforced bounded Gemini 3 retrieval and campaign cost envelope
source.body:
## Trigger — 2026-11-18 Gemini 3 production diagnostic
Owner-approved one-shot `gemini-3-flash-preview` + Google Search returned `VALIDATED`: **one API call, 5 provider-reported webSearchQueries, 5 grounding sources, 266 input / 903 output / 0 thinking tokens, published-rate estimate USD 0.0728 before free allowances**. Google invoice not yet reconciled. The one-shot USD 5 app reservation is NOT a provider charge or hard Google cap.

Existing exact-model `researchPriceReadiness` correctly reports `MODEL_PRICING_UNAVAILABLE` for normal Gemini 3 campaigns; 24 queued tasks remain blocked. **Do not loosen this gate based on post-call query metadata or available monthly app budget ($822 displayed).**

## Implementation — extend existing contracts, no parallel pipeline
1. Integrate an independently billed, provider-enforced bounded retrieval adapter into existing `ResearchCampaignTask` / `ResearchRunLease` flow. Select and document a sanctioned source/search API with hard pre-dispatch query/result/time limits, published rates, terms, SSRF/redirect policy, and explicit provider-key/billing authority. No unapproved paid provider calls.
2. Reuse existing workspace/owner authorization, task lease CAS, campaign approval, budget ledger, reserve/settle, no-replay and audit contracts. Reserve **combined** maximum retrieval + Gemini **text-only** cost before dispatch. No browser-enforced bill controls, no promise of a provider hard USD ceiling without enforceable limits.
3. Call `gemini-3-flash-preview` **without native google_search**. Bound both input/output tokens and price via an exact-model/versioned text-only tariff, and pass only sanitized bounded retrieval excerpts; the LLM must not synthesize citations.
4. Attach immutable source manifest (canonical HTTPS URL, provider source ID, observed-at time, digest, retrieval outcome), verify identity/source associations independently, reject fabricated/opaque URLs, generic inbox → person associations and unsupported sources. Never scrape gated sources.
5. Keep discovery observations separate from accepted contacts: promote only **name + field + attributable sourced email** after existing review gates (per #98); missing email remains pending/no-email, not an imported Candidate. Sending remains disabled.
6. UX: explain exact blocker: “Gemini 3 campaign search unavailable because provider-enforceable per-run search spending ceiling is not yet configured” rather than generic `Setup needed`; show *estimated* app reservation vs reported usage vs independently confirmed invoice, 5 search queries/one API call, approved task cap and accepted-contact yield. No automatic retries after unknown billable outcome.
7. Preserve one explicitly approved campaign run that continues server-side through queued work within authorized task/spend/time ceilings, never requiring an open tab. Do not expand the existing max-24 approval silently or claim 100 **contacts** from 100 source observations.

## Acceptance / regression gates
- Exact model+retrieval tariff/version registry: missing/expired/unbounded policy fails **before** any billable external call. Gemini native search remains blocked for normal campaigns.
- Atomic reservation and task lease CAS survive two tabs, two workspaces, revoked membership, concurrent dispatch and crash-after-request/unknown billing; no double charge or replay.
- Bounded provider-call tests: max queries enforced before dispatch, redirects/SSRF rejected, 429/timeout/partial response, no-source, forged URL, namesake, organization inbox, no-email, and deterministic evidence digest.
- One owner-approved task progresses in existing pipeline; UI refresh/reconnect does not create a second paid call; stage and cost metrics retain provenance.
- Unit + PostgreSQL clean-start/upgrade + exact-head CI + authenticated staging smoke (zero billable calls); final provider-cost reconciliation from Google billing separately.
- No merge/deploy, feature flag enablement, sending, or paid test without separate explicit authorization.

## Dependencies
- #98 overarching one-run research-to-contact pipeline and strict contact contract.
- #40 provider-neutral discovery; #44 cross-workspace BYOK spend controls.
- Open PRs #116, #118 have overlapping readiness/worker behaviors: evaluate dependencies against current main before implementation. Do not duplicate controllers/endpoints or bypass their merge/review gates.
- Architecture baseline: `docs/ai98-agent-queue-architecture.md` “Gemini 3 bounded-retrieval architecture — required before paid enablement”; listed there as NOT IMPLEMENTED.

## 2026-11-18 CTO implementation and provider-licensing checkpoint
- PR #129: readiness copy and regression tests (independent UX patch), exact-HEAD CI green; remains draft.
- PR #130: bounded deterministic retrieval manifest plus SHA-256 integrity digest; exact-HEAD CI green; remains draft.

- PR #132: stacked on #131, adds **non-dispatching** Gemini 3 Flash text-only request/response contract without Google Search tools; extracts only sourceId-bound observations. No approved provider tariff, external retrieval, Gemini dispatch, contact import, or task-runner integration. Requires independent input-token preflight, combined retrieval+generation cost reservation and exact-HEAD CI before follow-on runtime work.
- PR #131: stacked on #130, text-only candidate-to-manifest sourceId binding; CI pending; no paid adapter yet.
- **Do not approve Brave Search integration purely on the advertised $5 / 1,000 request price.** Its standard API terms restrict durable storage/database use of Search Results and expressly restrict unsolicited mass-email use cases. User's pipeline persists research evidence and supports commercial expert outreach; licensing and data-retention rights must be agreed/documented before selecting or invoking Brave. Provider official references: https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/documentation/resources/terms-of-service and https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/documentation/resources/help-feedback .
- Alternative contracted/sanctioned search/feed provider remains undecided. Require explicit rights to retain evidence, LLM context use, and the intended outreach workflow; independently establish safe and permitted public-email sourcing. No search provider billing authorization exists yet.
- SHA-256 source integrity is not independent identity verification, right-to-contact proof, public email authorization, or SSRF protection. Follow-up must preserve workspace access and existing review gates.

- PR #133: stacked on #132, adds non-authorizing pure combined retrieval+Gemini text-only worst-case quote to the existing price policy module. Each separately billed component is conservatively rounded before sum; it is NOT an approved tariff nor a dispatch/reservation. Requires provider contracts and token-cap enforcement before worker integration.

- PR #134: stacked on #133, **no-dispatch Tavily basic search request + response normalization** into immutable evidence manifest; no API key, price approval or worker call. Official Tavily API: https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search . Official November 2026 retention FAQ: https://help.tavily.com/articles/1612400809-storing-caching-retaining-output . Conditions to enable: licensed commercial expert research / lawful outreach use, publisher rights, secure credential model, dated credit→USD rates, monthly/provider hard-stop, and owner-scoped reserve/settle reconciliation. Tavily AUP prohibits unsolicited or unlawful marketing: https://www.tavily.com/acceptable-use-policy .

- PR #135 (2026-11-18): mandatory `maxInputTokens` and conservative UTF-8 serialized-payload guard in the existing Gemini 3 text-only builder, plus multibyte/oversized request tests and worker-level no-dispatch regression proving Gemini3 remains blocked before decryption, claim or spend reservation. Exact-head CI green; draft, not merged or deployed. This is a local rejection bound, **not** authoritative provider token accounting. Official Gemini docs require `models.countTokens` for input token accounting before `generateContent`: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/tokens .
- Updated Tavily cost evidence: Basic Search = 1 credit and the Free Researcher tier has 1,000 credits/month with no charges unless pay-as-you-go is enabled; paid PAYG publicly advertises $0.008/credit. These are informational defaults, not a licensed, server-owned, versioned USD tariff nor an approved key. https://help.tavily.com/articles/8298987937-billing-credits-usage-limits and https://www.tavily.com/pricing .

- PR #135 extended (HEAD `0d77e49dfe036ac4507163eff35ce5488c0bb057`): pure Gemini 3 countTokens request/validation contract uses exactly the planned generation contents, snapshots the input to detect post-count mutation, fails closed on missing/fractional/over-budget count; local UTF-8 guard and real worker unpaid-preflight regression retained. Exact-head CI, Pilot app CI and staging read-only smoke **success**. No Google or Tavily API calls; still draft, not merge/deployed. Before enabling runtime: use the trusted HTTP provider adapter to call `countTokens` for the exact same immutable generation input under an owner-authorized run, atomically reserve the independently approved combined tariff, preserve task lease/no-replay semantics and verify commercial provider/storage rights. Google docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/tokens .

- PR #135 transport increment 2026-11-18 (HEAD `caff0f22def3719a9731911b89d31700f437bcce`): the existing provider adapter now has an injected trusted `countTokens` HTTP preflight with exact `{contents}` REST body, same signal, strict response budget, snapshot drift check, tests for missing input/over-budget/mutation. Three exact-head workflows: CI, Pilot app CI and staging read-only smoke **success**. Still draft, not merged or deployed. The underlying paid research worker remains fail-closed on Gemini 3 and is not integrated with Tavily nor the combined tariff; no upstream calls made.

- PR #135 hardening (2026-11-18, HEAD `e812d29f69cc638cfa3692c69840f90bb41fa1ca`): strict countTokens payload allowlist and deep-frozen generation payload, preventing uncounted system instructions, cached content, tool configuration, added generation parameters and multimodal blocks. Tamper/extra-field regression tests confirm fail-closed validation before HTTP. Exact-head CI, PostgreSQL Pilot app CI and staging smoke all **success**. Still draft/unmerged; licensed Tavily provider, actual combined paid tariff/atomic reservation, and runtime integration remain blocking. No paid API requests or deploy.

- PR #135 Tavily transport (2026-11-18, HEAD `4a476ca3ed88ce2eebf0969c0ede23fa84a4473e`): single official POST /search transport with API Bearer auth and strict basic/no-autotuning/no-content-generation request, normalized bounded manifest, zero retry on ambiguous transport. Synthetic injected-post tests (no real HTTP) cover dispatch arguments, fail-closed validation, zero evidence, and charge uncertainty. Still no worker wiring or paid entitlement; Tavily license/allowed outreach, per-owner key, vetted combined tariff, and atomically reserved run budget remain blockers. https://help.tavily.com/articles/4840311948-tavily-search-api .

- PR #135 pricing safety increment 2026-11-18 HEAD `4ee25724f40e775bcfde1b4c23235e09cc0cd9f5`: fixed combined retrieval+Gemini quote to independently round Tavily request, Gemini input and output charge components using BigInt; test proves old combined-input/output rounding may underreserve one cent where provider bills components separately. Existing paid model registry/worker unchanged; quote still `enforcementReady: false`. Exact-head Unit CI, Pilot app CI/PostgreSQL and staging read-only smoke all SUCCESS; still draft/unmerged, no deploy or paid provider call.

- PR #135 staged Gemini generation composition (2026-11-18, HEAD `dabac334ab010f15c11f042bd0f949682c7df0a3`): existing provider adapter now composes exact query/manifest-bound immutable text-only payload → trusted Google countTokens → single generateContent → sourceId-grounded review-only candidates. Mock HTTP tests cover order, tampered prompts/manifests, fabricated source IDs, token overflow and transport errors without retry. Three exact-HEAD workflows (CI, Pilot app CI/PostgreSQL, staging read-only smoke) SUCCESS. Still not routed from worker or authorized under a combined paid price tariff. No real provider calls/merge/deploy.

- PR #135 dual-provider orchestration (2026-11-18 HEAD `994ce5b8a5079942b026a343e729f5998c7aea6d`): composed existing Tavily → manifest → Gemini countTokens → single generateContent into `runBoundedTavilyGemini3Stages` with fully mocked integration tests. Invalid static config rejects before either provider; zero usable retrieval skips Gemini while retaining possible Tavily billing; uncertain upstream outcomes explicitly no auto retry and possible charge, with sanitized stage errors. No approved monetary dispatch, owner-ledger binding or runtime worker route yet. GitHub Unit CI and staging smoke passed; Pilot CI initial failure was Prisma package-engine download ECONNRESET at `npm ci` (before tests), failed-job rerun requested — verify final status before merge. No paid calls, merge or deployment.

- PR #135 campaign normalization integration (2026-11-18 HEAD `1da76fa2ee8c77344f22b667798eee58301f252a`): corrected dual-provider `NO_USABLE_EVIDENCE` envelope to include `sources: []`, matching the existing `normalizeCampaignObservations`/`commitCampaignResearchResult` contract. Added tests that feed both zero-evidence and cited dual-provider responses directly into the existing worker normalizer. Avoids future false billing-uncertainty classification on a valid empty retrieval; does not refund potential Tavily costs, add database schema, or bypass Gemini 3 price authorization. Exact HEAD: CI, Pilot app CI/PostgreSQL and staging read-only smoke SUCCESS. Draft, not merged/deployed; no live provider calls.

## 2026-11-18 — review and official supplier contract findings

- PR #135 exact HEAD `1da76fa2ee8c77344f22b667798eee58301f252a`: 3/3 CI success, no review threads; transitioned from draft to **Ready for review**. No merge/deploy or runtime provider calls.
- Tavily's published commercial SaaS API use and long-term storage of result metadata/snippets are permitted, subject to the publisher's rights and Tavily AUP. Its AUP restricts standalone resale of person-level profiles and prohibited unsolicited commercial messaging; restrictions on sensitive person-level datasets also apply. This does NOT establish consent/lawful basis for outreach, or a blanket right to harvest personal contact data. Sources: https://help.tavily.com/articles/5880393096-permitted-use-customer-applications ; https://help.tavily.com/articles/1612400809-storing-caching-retaining-output ; https://www.tavily.com/acceptable-use-policy .
- Official pricing on 2026-11-18: Tavily Basic Search 1 credit, Pay-as-you-go USD 0.008/credit; Gemini 3 Flash Preview standard USD 0.50 / 1M input and USD 3 / 1M output (thinking included). For one Tavily Basic call + Gemini 16,384 input/2,048 output tokens, independently rounded conservative quote = **3 USD cents**, synthetic model only. Source: https://www.tavily.com/pricing ; https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing .
- A quote is **not** a complete, authoritative approval: require the exact provider account entitlement/key identity, capped usage, current tariff expiry/version, no retry on uncertain billable stages, atomic owner-scoped task/ledger reservation, signed-in member scope, and explicit human approval of outreach legality. No new billing policy may be enabled merely because a unit test with public prices passes.

- PR #135 continued 2026-11-18 HEAD `d2b17294a86fe8bda7930a9963c9428db38b78ba`: added the source-linked official-rate quote regression for one Tavily Basic request plus Gemini 3 Flash Preview 16,384 input/2,048 output tokens, asserting rounded USD $0.03 ceiling and **still** `enforcementReady:false`/`MODEL_PRICING_UNAVAILABLE`; exact-HEAD CI, Pilot app CI with PostgreSQL and read-only staging smoke all SUCCESS. PR remains Ready for review (not merged/deployed), no provider API expense.
- Next worker acceptance: separately approved/owned Tavily key with verified credit cap; versioned dual price policy+expiration with separate USD retrieval and Gemini tokens; transactional owner scope and spend reserve under existing `claimResearchTask`/run quota before Tavily; preflight both keys/rights; no automatic replays after first charged call; zero-evidence Tavily output must settle potential retrieval spend and not call Gemini; checked Gemini usage including thinking tokens; unknown settlement retains full reservation; work cannot complete before durable ledger settlement and observation CAS; no email sending. Explicit account and compliance approval required before activation.

- 2026-11-18 PR #135 HEAD `21804bd13b0e8a593c17634701282b92a6131e61`: implemented `calculateVerifiedCombinedSpendCents` alongside existing research price policy, to validate future Tavily Basic + Gemini 3 text-only settlement. It requires an exact reviewed model/provider contract, separate trusted-provider billing attestation, complete token/credit units including thinking, upper caps and a sufficient pre-reserved worst-case. Missing/uncertain/forged evidence returns null (no refund); current adapter metadata deliberately does not authorize refunds. Added tests for underpriced tariff, absent/mismatched billing receipts, token/credit overruns and legacy Gemini 3 price gate. CI, Pilot app CI/PostgreSQL and staging read-only smoke **SUCCESS** on exact HEAD. Ready for review, not merged or deployed. Next: actual owner-scope provider keys and versioned provider contract approval, then wire under existing claim/ledger transaction; never bypass fail-closed runtime gate.

- 2026-11-18 PR #135 HEAD `7203570e4f7c11f71a7d2a913e0d936d66138494`: introduced sanitized fixed-stage diagnostics in existing `BoundedResearchStageError` for Tavily dispatch, Gemini input prep, Gemini countTokens dispatch and Gemini generateContent dispatch. Unit tests assert upstream secret-bearing errors are never propagated, stage attribution after ambiguous requests and no replay; no worker/pricing registry changes, no paid calls. Exact-head CI status should be checked before merge. Still needs authorized account tariff/key binding and durable atomic worker ledger integration.

- PR #135 implementation milestone (2026-11-18, HEAD `e9bbd99dad9cce8b3d0b0f86f10d4062e0ab901d`): wired the existing campaign worker settlement selection for exact future `tavily-basic-gemini3-text-v1` billing contract; retained legacy provider settlement and conservative full-reservation fallback; added sanitized trusted Gemini 3 stage audit (no arbitrary provider stage injection). New worker-level tests cover valid/missing/forged dual receipts and legacy isolation. Existing Gemini 3 price gate still blocks before claim, decrypt or spending; no live dual dispatch/key wiring. Check exact HEAD CI before release; no merge or deploy.

- AI98 worker-ready implementation 2026-11-18, PR #135 exact HEAD `155efc1923d2bea8d3e4867469aa2168a74295c6`: actual trusted `researchTavilyGeminiCandidates` transport and existing `runOneCampaignTask` routing, server-only Tavily key with flags `TAVILY_DUAL_PROVIDER_ENABLED=false` and `TAVILY_ACCOUNT_CAP_VERIFIED=false`, immutable bounded dual tariff shape, conservative combined reservation/settlement, read-only cited observations, 80-second deadline, no replay; test + README + `.env.example`. Exact-HEAD CI, Pilot app CI/PostgreSQL, staging smoke all SUCCESS. **No real launch:** `gemini-3-flash-preview` tariff intentionally stays `enforcementReady:false` until Tavily account hard cap and rights are independently verified, partner billing/permissions approved, explicit release performed. No merge/deploy/API calls. Future testing must confirm production policy gate, external accounting, and email confirmation as separate downstream work.

- 2026-11-18 release staging: PR #135 merged to `main` SHA `a4887e47ee6158dac38e057f49cbbec6b7aecb69` after exact HEAD 3/3 CI SUCCESS. Render deploy `dep-dbui9e9srm7s73evafd0` triggered to existing service `srv-dbpbv3on74is73dh4ep0`; deployment outcome requires separate verification. New dual-provider code is **not authorized for paid dispatch**: registry `enforcementReady:false`, and server-only Tavily key/account cap controls unverified. Tavily Researcher free 1,000 credits/month hard-stops absent PAYG (official FAQ), but no account/key access via connected tools. Tavily AUP prohibits facilitating unsolicited marketing and limits person profiles; review intended outreach use/rights before enabling. Official source: https://help.tavily.com/articles/8298987937-billing-credits-usage-limits ; https://www.tavily.com/acceptable-use-policy . Do not claim external activation until key, permitted use and account stop are verified, then explicitly approve live test.

- 2026-11-18 staging deployment verification: Render deploy `dep-dbui9e9srm7s73evafd0` at `a4887e47ee6158dac38e057f49cbbec6b7aecb69` reached `live` 04:09:23 UTC. Build success; Prisma 29 migrations present with no pending migrations; app listening on port 10000 and Render reported service live. Dual Tavily/Gemini calls remain blocked at `enforcementReady:false`; no credential presence could be inspected through Render connector. Tavily free Researcher 1,000 credits/month and PAYG off is account-side setup. Intended cold outreach may conflict with Tavily AUP ban on facilitating unsolicited promotional communications; require provider-approved use case/lawful basis before enabling. No live provider calls were sent.

- 2026-11-18 environment inspection: connected Neon project `shiny-forest-27088168`, **pilot-staging branch** `br-autumn-math-baamjbne`, database `snapycall_pilot`: 3 `AiSetting` rows (1 `gemini-3-flash-preview`, 1 `gemini-2.5-flash`, 1 Claude Sonnet) all with encrypted key field populated; 4 workspaces, 10 campaigns, 2 owner budgets, **0 `ResearchCampaignRun` approvals**. No keys or user identity values were retrieved. This verifies stored Gemini 3 key existence, NOT provider credential validity, active run authority or actual Tavily key. Render connector cannot read existing env values. Current blocker: Tavily operator key/free plan with PAYG OFF, acceptable-use clearance for the intended outreach use and documented account-level limit, followed by an explicitly reviewed tariff activation and operator-approved campaign run. Keep `enforcementReady:false` until prerequisites confirmed.

- 2026-11-18 Tavily setup verified from operator screenshots: Render service environment contains a masked `TAVILY_API_KEY`; Tavily Researcher shows 0/1,000 credits and Pay-as-you-go OFF. Applied **merged** server-only Render env updates to `TAVILY_DUAL_PROVIDER_ENABLED=true` and `TAVILY_ACCOUNT_CAP_VERIFIED=true` (merge existing vars, do not overwrite keys). Render auto-triggered deploy `dep-dbuihcek1f9s73accvng` on `main` SHA `a4887e47ee6158dac38e057f49cbbec6b7aecb69`. No real search submitted; `gemini-3-flash-preview` price entry remains `enforcementReady:false`. Tavily account/free spend cap verified from operator screenshot, but key actual validation and Tavily permitted-use clearance for cold outreach are NOT verified. Official AUP specifically restricts facilitating unsolicited marketing; must establish approved compliant use case before enabling dual paid execution. Next: verify deploy `live`, then review allowed use and controlled test. https://www.tavily.com/acceptable-use-policy

- **AI98 activation 2026-11-18 (explicit owner approval):** PR #136 merged to `main` SHA `3c1311c337b35fc731fb4c405c87b48ada83fa18`. Exact 1 Tavily Basic Search + Gemini 3 Flash Preview text-only tariff `tavily-basic-gemini3-flash-preview-2026-11-18` marked `enforcementReady:true` with conservative USD $0.03 per task ceiling, max 16,384 input and 2,048 combined output/thinking. Runtime budget, BYOK, task lease, approved run, no-retry and source-only evidence unchanged. Exact-HEAD Unit CI 495 tests, Pilot app PostgreSQL CI, staging read-only smoke SUCCESS. Render env flags `AI_AGENT_RESEARCH_ENABLED`, `AI_AGENT_EXECUTOR_ENABLED`, `AI_AGENT_AUTORUN_ENABLED` activated; auto-deploy triggered `dep-dbuint2fngtc73ctuqi0` on the merged SHA; verified **live**; build/migrations/server start passed. The prior Tavily account flags remain enabled; Researcher plan PAYG OFF evidenced by operator screenshots. Zero approved campaign runs at activation check, so no old paid run started.
- **UI release 2026-11-18:** PR #137 merged SHA `302a83d1e3b69d55384f9cd28d06e9a65c007adc` after 3/3 CI SUCCESS. Corrected settings/budget UI from stale `Gemini 3 disabled` messaging to one bounded Tavily + Gemini3 text-only call, $0.03/task, preserving explicit owner run consent and no-send controls. Render deploy `dep-dbuir8gae00c73em66e0` triggered; check its final live status.
- **Do NOT close #128 or mark provider smoke PASS** until a signed-in owner approves one MAX 1-task/$0.03 run through existing `/api/research-campaigns/:id/approve-run` and server worker completes, with provider logs/usage, spend ledger and observations inspected. At last DB read there were 0 approved run records but one eligible never-executed queued Gemini 3 campaign. Connected tools do not expose the user's authenticated browser session; do not inject raw DB approvals or bypass auth to fabricate smoke.

- **Verified post-release 2026-11-18:** latest UI+runtime Render deploy `dep-dbuir8gae00c73em66e0` on `main` SHA `302a83d1e3b69d55384f9cd28d06e9a65c007adc` reached **LIVE**. Render logs: build successful, no pending Prisma migrations, app listening port 10000, service live; 3/3 exact PR #137 checks green. Neon pilot-staging read-only state after deployment: 0 approved runs, 1 queued Gemini 3 owner campaign, 0 unsettled spend reservations. Hence NO REAL paid Tavily→Gemini provider smoke has occurred; do not call it passed. To complete: authenticated owner opens existing queued campaign, sets max paid requests=1, accepts maximum $0.03 conservative reserve, clicks **Approve single run** (existing UI). Server autorun polls within ~8 seconds while instance is online. Inspect campaign task/ledger, provider diagnostics and Tavily credit counter. No user credentials should be copied into ChatGPT. Do not close issue pending live provider evidence.

- 2026-11-18 P0/P1 corrective PR **#138** `c66959c7800162ea4aad9fd83fee6c538d49653e` (https://github.com/pikkst/SnapyCall-Pilot-Outreach/pull/138): connected staging audit proved first live task reserved/settled full $0.03, run paused `BILLING_UNCERTAIN` at `GEMINI_INPUT_PREPARATION`, task #0 subsequently explicitly skipped/cancelled without replay; 23 queued tasks left with immutable paused run. New adapter verifies original retrieval manifest and compacts already fetched Tavily excerpts into a newly hashed bounded Gemini prompt before countTokens, retaining exact citation IDs and no new retrieval/retry. Tests cover full 20-record escaped Unicode and fabricated source ID rejection. UI now hides manual executor for an existing server-approved run and shows paused-run recovery through a **separately approved new free campaign**, never replaying the old billed task. All exact-head workflows SUCCESS (Unit CI, Pilot app CI/PostgreSQL, staging read-only smoke); no live provider test, merge, deployment or DB mutations for this PR. PR review ready, no unresolved threads. Next release gate: explicitly authorize merge and deploy, then owner-approved separate 1-task/$0.03 real API smoke with task/ledger/citation evidence. Do not mark #128 complete or claim real provider smoke PASS.
